text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A Malawian mother Jennifer Sadiki on Wednesday vowed she would never give birth again after her youngest baby turned out a strange Siamese twin with one head and joined to another body at the heart. Doctors say the baby has an extra body that grows out of the trunk.

- A cabinet minister hired the highly organised Blantyre township gang The Lebanese to cause anarchy and arson at an opposition Malawi Congress Party campagin rally two weeks ago where they burnt a Land Rover.

- Business grounded to a halt when hundreds of workers from the Agricultural Development Martketing Corporation on Wednesday marched for three kilometres to protest against a 10 percent wage increase, saying it was too little.
